search_query: What version of YAML is in Kubernetes 1.31?
reachability_classification: Production Reachable (API server admission & kubelet control loop)
direct_answer_summary: Kubernetes v1.31.0 utilizes sigs.k8s.io/yaml v1.4.0 to parse and convert incoming YAML manifests into JSON across the API server, kubectl, and kubelet. It unmarshals YAML into Go structs using standard JSON schema tags, while pinning gopkg.in/yaml.v3 v3.0.1 for duplicate key rejection.

search_query: What version of OpenSSL is in Node.js 22 LTS?
direct_answer_summary: Node.js v22.6.0 embeds OpenSSL 3.0.13+quic as its primary cryptographic runtime engine, providing default TLS 1.3 ciphers, modernized provider architecture, and QUIC packet parsing primitives. Legacy cryptographic algorithms are disabled by default and require explicit legacy provider invocation.

search_query: What version of OpenSSL is in Python 3.12?
direct_answer_summary: Python v3.12.5 (CPython) utilizes OpenSSL 3.0.13 as its canonical cryptographic and TLS engine via the standard library _ssl and _hashlib C-extensions. On Linux, Python links dynamically against the host system's libssl.so.3 and libcrypto.so.3, while official macOS and Windows installer binaries statically bundle OpenSSL 3.0.
